name: Hakudo Co., Ltd.
summary: Hakudo Co., Ltd. processes and sells plates, bars, aluminum tubes, elongated copper products, stainless steels, and plastics in Japan and internationally. It offers high performance alloys; lead less and cadmium less copper and aluminum; aerospace standard compliant material; aluminum; stainless steel; copper; special steels; titanium/others; plastics; high precision aluminum plates; and annealed copper and stainless steel. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
